048/**
049 *
050 */
051public class SQLReceipt implements Datable<Receipt> {
052
053  /**
054   * The class that is represented by the O parameter.
055   *
056   * @return The class that represents the parameter.
057   */
058  @Override
059  public Class<? extends Receipt> clazz() {
060
061    return Receipt.class;
062  }
063
064  /**
065   * USed to purge the objects of this datable.
066   *
067   * @param connector The storage connector to use for this transaction.
068   */
069  @Override
070  public void purge(final StorageConnector<?> connector) {
071
072    if(connector instanceof final SQLConnector sql && sql.dialect() instanceof final TNEDialect tne) {
073      sql.executeUpdate(tne.receiptPurge(DataConfig.yaml().getInt("Data.Purge.Transaction.Days")),
074                        new Object[]{});
075    }
076  }
077
078  /**
079   * Used to store this object.
080   *
081   * @param connector The storage connector to use for this transaction.
082   * @param receipt   The object to be stored.
083   */
084  @Override
085  public void store(final StorageConnector<?> connector, @NotNull final Receipt receipt, @Nullable final String identifier) {
086
087    if(connector instanceof final SQLConnector sql && sql.dialect() instanceof final TNEDialect tne) {
088
089      //Store the receipt info
090      sql.executeUpdate(tne.saveReceipt(),
091                        new Object[]{
092                                receipt.getId().toString(),
093                                new java.sql.Timestamp(receipt.getTime()),
094                                receipt.getType(),
095                                receipt.getSource().name(),
096                                receipt.getSource().type(),
097                                receipt.isArchive(),
098                                receipt.isVoided(),
099                                receipt.isArchive(),
100                                receipt.isVoided()
101                        });
102
103      storeParticipant(connector, receipt.getFrom(), receipt.getModifierFrom(), "from", receipt.getId().toString());
104      storeParticipant(connector, receipt.getTo(), receipt.getModifierTo(), "to", receipt.getId().toString());
105      receipt.clearDirty();
106    }
107  }
108
109  private void storeParticipant(final StorageConnector<?> connector, @Nullable final TransactionParticipant participant,
110                                @Nullable final HoldingsModifier modifier, final String type, @NotNull final String identifier) {
111
112    if(connector instanceof final SQLConnector sql && sql.dialect() instanceof final TNEDialect tne
113       && participant != null && modifier != null) {
114
115      //store participant info
116      sql.executeUpdate(tne.saveParticipant(),
117                        new Object[]{
118                                identifier,
119                                participant.getId().toString(),
120                                type,
121                                participant.getTax()
122                        });
123
124      //store holdings
125      for(final HoldingsEntry entry : participant.getStartingBalances()) {
126        storeReceiptHolding(connector, entry, participant.getId().toString(), identifier, false);
127      }
128
129      for(final HoldingsEntry entry : participant.getEndingBalances()) {
130        storeReceiptHolding(connector, entry, participant.getId().toString(), identifier, true);
131      }
132
133      //store modifier
134      sql.executeUpdate(tne.saveModifier(),
135                        new Object[]{
136                                identifier,
137                                participant.getId().toString(),
138                                type,
139                                modifier.getOperation().name(),
140                                modifier.getRegion(),
141                                modifier.getCurrency().toString(),
142                                modifier.getModifier()
143                        });
144    }
145  }
146
147  private void storeReceiptHolding(final StorageConnector<?> connector, @NotNull final HoldingsEntry entry, final String participant,
148                                   final String receipt, final boolean ending) {
149
150    if(connector instanceof final SQLConnector sql && sql.dialect() instanceof final TNEDialect tne) {
151      sql.executeUpdate(tne.saveReceiptHolding(),
152                        new Object[]{
153                                receipt,
154                                participant,
155                                ending,
156                                MainConfig.yaml().getString("Core.Server.Name"),
157                                entry.getRegion(),
158                                entry.getCurrency().toString(),
159                                entry.getHandler().asID(),
160                                entry.getAmount()
161                        });
162    }
163  }
164
165  /**
166   * Used to store all objects of this type.
167   *
168   * @param connector The storage connector to use for this transaction.
169   */
170  @Override
171  public void storeAll(final StorageConnector<?> connector, @Nullable final String identifier) {
172
173    if(connector instanceof SQLConnector) {
174
175      for(final Receipt receipt : TransactionManager.receipts().getReceipts().values()) {
176        if(receipt.isDirty()) {
177          store(connector, receipt, identifier);
178        }
179      }
180    }
181  }
182
183  @Override
184  public void delete(final StorageConnector<?> connector, @NotNull final String identifier) {
185    //nothing to do here.
186  }
187
188  /**
189   * Used to load this object.
190   *
191   * @param connector  The storage connector to use for this transaction.
192   * @param identifier The identifier used to identify the object to load.
193   *
194   * @return The object to load.
195   */
196  @Override
197  public Optional<Receipt> load(final StorageConnector<?> connector, @NotNull final String identifier) {
198
199    //We shouldn't load individual Receipts, it doesn't make sense to me/no use case with caching. - creatorfromhell
200    return Optional.empty();
201  }
202
203  /**
204   * Loads a Receipt object from a ResultSet.
205   *
206   * @param result The ResultSet containing the data to load into a Receipt object.
207   *
208   * @return An Optional containing the loaded Receipt object. Returns an empty Optional if the
209   * ResultSet is empty.
210   *
211   * @throws SQLException if an error occurs while accessing the ResultSet data.
212   */
213  public Receipt load(final ResultSet result, final SQLConnector sql, final TNEDialect dialect) throws SQLException {
214
215    //SQL Columns: uid, performed, receipt_type, receipt_source, receipt_source_type, archive, voided
216    final Receipt receipt = new Receipt(
217            UUID.fromString(result.getString("uid")),
218            result.getTimestamp("performed").getTime(),
219            result.getString("receipt_type")
220    );
221    receipt.setSource(ActionSource.create(result.getString("receipt_source"), result.getString("receipt_source_type")));
222    receipt.setArchive(result.getBoolean("archive"));
223    receipt.setVoided(result.getBoolean("voided"));
224    receipt.clearDirty();
225
226    return receipt;
227  }
228
229  public void loadParticipants(final Receipt receipt, final SQLConnector sql, final TNEDialect dialect) {
230
231    try(final ResultSet result = sql.executeQuery(dialect.loadParticipants(), new Object[]{
232            receipt.getId().toString() })) {
233      while(result.next()) {
234
235        final String type = result.getString("participant_type").toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
236        final UUID id = UUID.fromString(result.getString("participant"));
237        final BigDecimal tax = result.getBigDecimal("tax");
238
239        final TransactionParticipant participant = new TransactionParticipant(id, new ArrayList<>());
240        participant.getStartingBalances().addAll(loadHoldings(receipt.getId(), id, false, sql, dialect));
241        participant.getEndingBalances().addAll(loadHoldings(receipt.getId(), id, true, sql, dialect));
242
243        participant.setTax(tax);
244        final Optional<HoldingsModifier> modifier = loadModifier(receipt.getId(), id, type, sql, dialect);
245
246        if(type.equals("from")) {
247          receipt.setFrom(participant);
248          modifier.ifPresent(receipt::setModifierFrom);
249        } else {
250          receipt.setTo(participant);
251          modifier.ifPresent(receipt::setModifierTo);
252        }
253      }
254    } catch(final Exception ignore) { }
255  }
256
257  public Optional<HoldingsModifier> loadModifier(final UUID receiptID, final UUID participant,
258                                                 final String type, final SQLConnector sql, final TNEDialect dialect) {
259
260    HoldingsModifier modifier = null;
261    //participant, participant_type, operation, region, currency AS currency, modifier  - uid/participant
262    try(final ResultSet result = sql.executeQuery(dialect.loadModifiers(), new Object[]{
263            receiptID.toString(), participant.toString(), type })) {
264
265      if(result.next()) {
266
267        modifier = new HoldingsModifier(
268                result.getString("region"),
269                UUID.fromString(result.getString("currency")),
270                result.getBigDecimal("modifier"),
271                HoldingsOperation.valueOf(result.getString("operation")));
272      }
273    } catch(final Exception ignore) { }
274    return Optional.ofNullable(modifier);
275  }
276
277  public List<HoldingsEntry> loadHoldings(final UUID receiptID, final UUID participant, final boolean ending,
278                                          final SQLConnector sql, final TNEDialect dialect) {
279
280    final List<HoldingsEntry> holdings = new ArrayList<>();
281
282    //participant, ending, server, region, currency AS currency, holdings_type, holdings - uid/participant
283    try(final ResultSet result = sql.executeQuery(dialect.loadReceiptHolding(), new Object[]{
284            receiptID.toString(), participant.toString(), ending })) {
285
286      while(result.next()) {
287
288        final HoldingsEntry entry = new HoldingsEntry(
289                result.getString("region"),
290                UUID.fromString(result.getString("currency")),
291                result.getBigDecimal("holdings"),
292                Identifier.fromID(result.getString("holdings_type"))
293        );
294        holdings.add(entry);
295      }
296    } catch(final Exception ignore) { }
297
298    return holdings;
299  }
300
301  /**
302   * Used to load all objects of this type.
303   *
304   * @param connector The storage connector to use for this transaction.
305   *
306   * @return A collection containing the objects loaded.
307   */
308  @Override
309  public Collection<Receipt> loadAll(final StorageConnector<?> connector, @Nullable final String identifier) {
310
311    final Collection<Receipt> receipts = new ArrayList<>(); // is this required? Not entirely sure it is - seems maybe a waste
312    if(connector instanceof final SQLConnector sql && sql.dialect() instanceof final TNEDialect tne) {
313
314      try(final ResultSet result = sql.executeQuery(tne.loadReceipts(), new Object[0])) {
315
316        while(result.next()) {
317
318          final Receipt receipt = load(result, sql, tne);
319
320          receipts.add(receipt);
321          TransactionManager.receipts().log(receipt);
322        }
323
324      } catch(final Exception ignore) { }
325    }
326    return receipts;
327  }
328}
